subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should `sessions.abort` permanently expose `clearQueued` so a selected non-global channel-session stop discards that session’s queued successors, rather than only aborting currently active work?
rationale: This is an additive but externally callable Gateway protocol behavior that intentionally changes what a session stop means for queued user work; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the permanent cancellation contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow opt-in contract
options.body: Keep `clearQueued` limited to explicit key-only non-global requests, retain existing defaults for all other callers, and require exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Abort active work only
options.body: Remove the queue-discard behavior and retain the selected-session stop as an active-run cancellation only, avoiding deletion of queued successors.

options.title: Pause for wider cancellation semantics
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define whether queue cleanup belongs in `sessions.abort` or a separate explicit cancellation operation.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Keep `clearQueued` limited to explicit key-only non-global requests, retain existing defaults for all other callers, and require exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available implementation history for the preceding and current selected-channel-stop designs.
